trans-unit.source: Auto Sync Files: Download only
Periodically downloads a file from an external URL and stores it in your web space, e.g. the Google Analytics script.
Auto Sync Files: Download & extract
Periodically downloads an archive (ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ) and extracts it into a target folder, either in addition to the existing files or as a complete replacement.
Download URL
Download URL (e.g. https://example.com/file.txt)
e.g. https://example.com/file.txt
e.g. https://example.com/archive.zip
Local path (absolute path inside the TYPO3 public directory)
Replace mode
Replace the contents of the target folder completely (existing files are deleted first)
Enabled: all files and subfolders in the target folder are deleted and replaced by the contents of the archive, but only after the archive has been extracted completely.
Disabled (default, merge mode): the files from the archive are added to the target folder and overwrite files with the same name. All other files in the target folder are kept.
The target folder itself is never deleted. Replace mode cannot be used for the TYPO3 public directory or for typo3temp/.
Clear cache
Flush frontend caches when the files have changed
